summary.fallback: Help an unemployed specialist get back on their feet and prove they are ready for town work.

intro.fallback: I know a trade, but I need help getting established before I can promise my work to a town.

return.fallback: You came back. That tells me more than the supplies do.

reward.fallback: I am ready to discuss a proper position in your town.

done.fallback: We have been introduced properly. If you have a workplace, I am ready.
